title: Formalize the degree-theoretic proof in BorsukUlam

problemStatement.formal: \text{No continuous odd map } g : S^n \to S^{n-1} \text{ exists } (n \ge 1); \text{ equivalently, } \nexists\, g : S^n \to \mathbb{R}^n \text{ continuous with } g(-x) = -g(x) \text{ and } g(x) \neq 0 \text{ for all } x \in S^n.
problemStatement.plain: The n-dimensional Borsuk-Ulam theorem is proved in the gallery, but its topological heart is currently assumed as the axiom no_continuous_odd_nonzero_on_sphere: that no continuous odd map from the n-sphere to the (n-1)-sphere exists. This problem asks for a machine-checked proof of that single obstruction in Lean 4 / Mathlib so the axiom can be replaced by a theorem and the parent entry upgraded toward verified status.
whyMatters: The odd-map obstruction is exactly where Borsuk-Ulam stops being elementary: n=1 needs only the IVT, but n>=2 requires that odd self-maps of the sphere have odd degree and are never null-homotopic.
Removing this axiom would turn Borsuk-Ulam, No-Retraction, and the equivalence chain to the Brouwer Fixed Point theorem from conditionally proved into fully machine-checked results.
A formal proof would establish reusable Mathlib-level infrastructure (odd maps, degree parity, or a Z/2 index) for future algebraic-topology formalizations.

open: The axiom no_continuous_odd_nonzero_on_sphere in Proofs/BorsukUlam.lean is unproved for n >= 2.
Mathlib does not currently expose a ready-made 'odd maps have odd degree' or 'no odd map S^n -> S^{n-1}' lemma in directly usable form.
knownResults.goal: Prove no_continuous_odd_nonzero_on_sphere (equivalently, no continuous odd map S^n -> S^{n-1}) in Lean 4 with Mathlib for all n >= 1, and replace the axiom declaration in Proofs/BorsukUlam.lean with a theorem; the parent's derived corollaries already follow from it.
